description: Test suite for the ChatLog component in a chat application, verifying behavior such as message capping, pruning, rendering, and state management.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: Main class representing a chat log with methods for adding messages, starting/stopping streams, pruning, and rendering.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts an assistant stream with a given name and run ID.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an existing assistant stream based on run ID.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Starts a tool component in the chat log.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result of a tool component.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a BTW (by the way) inline message.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if a BTW message is currently visible.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, with an option to preserve pending users.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores pending user messages after a rebuild.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending users using timestamps, considering clock differences.
